title: DR1 labels the file field "Attachment"; the frontend labels it "Upload a file".

finding.frontend: The file field's label is "Upload a file" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:12), rendered in bold as a small label above the requirements list (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/template.njk:51-58). It repeats the page heading, "Upload documents", as an instruction rather than naming the thing being collected, which is out of step with the two fields above it — "Document reference" and "Date of issue" — which both name their answer.
finding.prototype: The same field is labelled "Attachment" (app/views/upload-documents.html:154-157) — a noun, consistent with the labels on the other three fields in the card, and the word DR1 uses for the file throughout the page.
finding.difference: Change the file field's label from "Upload a file" to "Attachment" in both language copy files. Copy only.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the frontend's file field labelled "Attachment" on the rendered page.

relatedTo.why: the label sits directly above the control being replaced
